text:
Hiro Tanaka: Quick note 10 mobile teams are asking for a way to surface non-fatal degradation to users. Right now a fallback to a tiny model or a soft throttle shows up as a 429/500 and the mobile UI throws an error toast. Can we add a small contract so clients can show a gentle "degraded but usable" state instead of an error?

Zoe Park: I ran into this too. Proposal: add client_status value SOFT_DEGRADED + soft_hint_ms when the service expects short recovery. SDKs treat SOFT_DEGRADED as non-exceptional but emit an event. This lets mobile show a spinner + message like "response may be degraded" rather than a failure toast.

Ben Torres: Love the UX angle. Telemetry notes: we need event.degrade_category (e.g., small-model, quantized, prefix-cache-miss) so dashboards can aggregate causes. Keep route_origin as a facet only. Also we must avoid adding many new HTTP statuses; keep 200/202/429/5xx unchanged and drive semantics from the JSON payload.

Hiro Tanaka: Agreed. Minimal fields: client_status (OK | SOFT_DEGRADED | RETRYABLE | THROTTLED | FAILED), soft_hint_ms optional, degrade_category optional enum, visible_message_key optional, visibility (public|internal). If visibility=public the SDK resolves visible_message_key for UI.

Zoe Park: Example payload we could publish to SDKs: ```json
{ "error": { "client_status": "SOFT_DEGRADED", "degrade_category": "fallback_small_model", "soft_hint_ms": 1500, "route_origin": "region-eu/fallback-small", "visibility": "public", "visible_message_key": "response.degraded.brief" } }
```

Ben Torres: SDK mapping rules: SOFT_DEGRADED -> don't throw; emit Telemetry.event('soft_degrade', {degrade_category, soft_hint_ms, route_origin}). UX teams can subscribe. RETRYABLE/THROTTLED/FAILED keep current mappings. Backcompat: if client_status missing, SDK uses legacy mapping (429->THROTTLED, 5xx->FAILED).

Hiro Tanaka: Console team request: add badge state "soft-degraded" (pale yellow) so customers see a non-critical degrade. Telemetry tags: event.client_status, event.degrade_category, metric.soft_hint_ms (p90 sample). We'll also include a sampled raw_error for initial rollout.

infra-bot: Feature flag created: client-soft-degrade-schema. Canary enabled for eng-platform at 2025-01-18T07:00Z.

Zoe Park: Rollout plan: start with opt-in tenants (per-tenant flag) at 5% for 48h, collect telemetry and UX feedback, then 25% for 72h, then ramp. Gate: rollback if user-visible FAILED increases by >2% or if median soft_hint_ms > 10s.

Ben Torres: Implementation notes: do not index route_origin as a primary metric; use aggregated degrade_category for dashboards. Add a console mapping table: OK->green, SOFT_DEGRADED->pale yellow + pattern, RETRYABLE/THROTTLED->amber, FAILED->red. Include runbook links for each.

Hiro Tanaka: I'll draft the RFC with schema + SDK examples + console badge mapping. Zoe, can you stub the locale keys (response.degraded.brief) for the UX team?

Zoe Park: Yep, will add short copy variants and locale bundle keys. Draft ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Ben Torres: I'll own telemetry dashboards and sampling knobs. Ping me when RFC lands and I'll wire alerts and the sampled raw_error view.

Hiro Tanaka: Thanks all 11 filing RFC at rfc/1756009999-soft-degrade-client-experience.md and will link here when posted.
